title: Source
description: An archived document that claims can be drawn from. A source is unusable as evidence until it has been hashed and archived.

$comment.description: Commentary on a fixture. Permitted in tests/fixtures only; validate.ts rejects this key anywhere under /data.

title_local.description: Title in the original script, if not English

tier.description: 1 = official primary record (gazette, affidavit, judgment, audit report). 2 = official secondary (press release, ministry dashboard export). 3 = institutional research with published methodology. There is no tier 4: the discover step ingests only from the official allowlist, so material weaker than tier 3 is not recordable in this archive at all. corroborating_evidence is for cross-checking one tier 1-3 source against another.
tier.$comment: Supersedes the original spec wording 'Tier 4 and below are not permitted as the sole evidence', which implied tier 4 records could exist, and the schema's 'Nothing below tier 3', which excluded tier 3 itself.

published_on.description: Date the document itself bears. Omit if the document is undated.

archive_url.description: Independent third-party archive copy, normally web.archive.org. This is the durability guarantee; storage_url is only a convenience copy.

storage_url.description: Your own object-store copy. Never a path inside this repository. Currently a GitHub release asset in the blobs repo; migrating hosts is a rewrite of this one field per record.

sha256.description: Of the retrieved bytes. validate.ts additionally rejects the all-zero placeholder, which matches this pattern but proves nothing.

retrieved_by.description: Handle of the person or the automated job id

text_layer.description: Claims extracted from an ocr layer must record ocr in claim.extraction.method

access_note.description: How this was obtained, e.g. RTI response number, portal path, request date

rights_note.description: Copyright or reuse status. Government works and third-party works are treated differently when quoting.

superseded_by.description: Set when a corrected or revised edition of this document is published
